commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Here's the change. Youssef En Nesyri leaves the pitch and Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
85' It's time for a substitution. Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) comes on in place of Manuel Bueno Sebastian.
85' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to make a change. Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) replaces Dodi Lukebakio.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inaki Williams departs the field of play to be replaced by Aingeru Olabarrieta (Ath Bilbao).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raul Garcia as he is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
78' The attendance for today's match is 44717.
75' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) replacing Nico Williams.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
70' Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
69' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Here is a change. Iker Muniain is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
62' The game is interrupted as Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
58' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
58' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
57' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
52' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
51' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul during an attacking move.
46' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to substitute Marcos Acuna and he is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Juan Pulido blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Kike Salas (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jesus Navas suffers an injury and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes on.
44' One of the players from Ath Bilbao times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
37' Sevilla are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
36' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

35' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the roof of the net. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Julen Agirrezabala and his brilliant save.
34' Sevilla are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
29' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Julen Agirrezabala, who smothers the ball.
28' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Juan Pulido had a clear view and blows his whistle.
23' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.

19' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Nico Williams, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao), who beats Orjan Nyland with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Oscar de Marcos is the provider and Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the top right corner from close in with his head. 1:0.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Orjan Nyland comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
15' Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.
15' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
8' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
6' A pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland and the move breaks down.
